title: "Ask the Work Planning agent (over A2A) to admit the next unit for a path"
description: "The PULL side of the execution/planning seam (ADR-0058): execution, whose claimable queue for a process path is draining, delegates 'admit the next priority-ordered unit' to the wes-work-planning A2A agent. Planning keeps every release decision (release policy, WIP invariant); execution keeps the judgement of when to ask. The authoritative fact still arrives as the `WorkReleased` CloudEvent on Kafka through the existing consumer — the 200 body is only the delegation acknowledgement. Each call asks for exactly one unit, so the route is behind the idempotency middleware (ADR-0058, ADR-0060): a retry of ONE logical pull (same `Idempotency-Key`, same path) replays the stored answer with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while a legitimate second pull sends a new key. Answers 503 when this deployment has no `WORK_PLANNING_A2A_URL` configured, and 502 when the planning agent is unreachable or answers off-contract."

The PULL side of the execution/planning seam (ADR-0058): execution, whose claimable queue for a process path is draining, delegates "admit the next priority-ordered unit" to the wes-work-planning A2A agent. Planning keeps every release decision (release policy, WIP invariant); execution keeps the judgement of when to ask. The authoritative fact still arrives as the `WorkReleased` CloudEvent on Kafka through the existing consumer — the 200 body is only the delegation acknowledgement. Each call asks for exactly one unit, so the route is behind the idempotency middleware (ADR-0058, ADR-0060): a retry of ONE logical pull (same `Idempotency-Key`, same path) replays the stored answer with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while a legitimate second pull sends a new key. Answers 503 when this deployment has no `WORK_PLANNING_A2A_URL` configured, and 502 when the planning agent is unreachable or answers off-contract.
